verdict.rationale: Dagster (with its hosted Dagster+ offering) handles customer data and metadata, so a buyer can fairly ask whether that data is excluded from AI model training. The axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers AI-training opt-out, data-usage policies, or privacy controls. The MCP server and AI skill items describe AI tooling, not training-data protections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
